guarantees.claim: new_o is continuously assigned to the value of new_q.
new_pulse_o is 1 when new_d is 1 and new_q is 0; otherwise 0.
clean_o is continuously assigned to the value of clean_q.

assumptions.claim: new_q must be the registered version of new_d (i.e., new_q holds the previous cycle's new_d value).
assumptions.risk: If new_q is not coherent with new_d, new_pulse_o may glitch or produce a false pulse, incorrectly triggering downstream logic.

uncertain_points.claim: The correctness of new_pulse_o depends on new_q being a properly delayed version of new_d. If the producer does not uphold this, false pulses may occur.
uncertain_points.cond: when new_d toggles and new_q is mismatched
uncertain_points.risk: Spurious new_pulse_o assertion could trigger unintended downstream actions or state transitions.
